options.formula:
{fldI7vQHsAgefemDF} & " – " &
DATETIME_FORMAT({fld2PARcG9yVQON3p}, "DD MMM") &
" to " &
DATETIME_FORMAT({fldML15xDDy3EJdJW}, "DD MMM YYYY")

IF(
  AND({fld2PARcG9yVQON3p},{fldML15xDDy3EJdJW}),
  (DATETIME_DIFF({fldML15xDDy3EJdJW},{fld2PARcG9yVQON3p},"days") + 1)
  -
  (
    2 * FLOOR((DATETIME_DIFF({fldML15xDDy3EJdJW},{fld2PARcG9yVQON3p},"days") + 1) / 7)
    +
    IF(
      MOD((DATETIME_DIFF({fldML15xDDy3EJdJW},{fld2PARcG9yVQON3p},"days") + 1), 7) = 0,
      0,
      IF(
        VALUE(DATETIME_FORMAT({fld2PARcG9yVQON3p}, "E")) + MOD((DATETIME_DIFF({fldML15xDDy3EJdJW},{fld2PARcG9yVQON3p},"days") + 1), 7) - 1 <= 7,
        IF(
          AND(
            VALUE(DATETIME_FORMAT({fld2PARcG9yVQON3p}, "E")) <= 6,
            VALUE(DATETIME_FORMAT({fld2PARcG9yVQON3p}, "E")) + MOD((DATETIME_DIFF({fldML15xDDy3EJdJW},{fld2PARcG9yVQON3p},"days") + 1), 7) - 1 >= 6
          ),
          1,
          0
        )
        +
        IF(
          AND(
            VALUE(DATETIME_FORMAT({fld2PARcG9yVQON3p}, "E")) <= 7,
            VALUE(DATETIME_FORMAT({fld2PARcG9yVQON3p}, "E")) + MOD((DATETIME_DIFF({fldML15xDDy3EJdJW},{fld2PARcG9yVQON3p},"days") + 1), 7) - 1 >= 7
          ),
          1,
          0
        ),
        IF(VALUE(DATETIME_FORMAT({fld2PARcG9yVQON3p}, "E")) <= 6, 1, 0) + 1
      )
    )
  )
)
